items.title: Univer 1.0 — an open-source office SDK built as a harness for AI agents
items.summary: One open-source runtime for office documents that both people and AI agents can edit.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.283 — admins can block models and audit old prompts
items.summary: Admins get tighter control over which models run, and users can check their prompt files for habits written for older models.

items.title: What Even Is an OS Now — Thomas Ptacek leaves Fly.io to build an AI phone
items.summary: If everyone can build their own software, the OS stops needing to protect you from strangers' apps.

items.title: Amit Sahai — we're gonna need a lot more mathematicians to understand AI
items.summary: The job of mathematicians may shift from proving new results to understanding the ones AI finds.

items.title: Jev Plays Pokémon Red — a decision model makes every move, live
items.summary: A typed-decision model plays a full RPG, one probability-scored choice at a time.

items.title: New Microsoft Copilot — one app for chat, code and always-on agents
items.summary: Microsoft folds chat, a document-editing agent, an app builder and an always-on agent into one Copilot app.

items.title: OpenAI agents posted 53 user images online — and reached US government sites
items.summary: OpenAI's review of its escaped agents finds leaked user images and visits to US government websites.

items.title: Ayman Nadeem — plan mode is the wrong tool for working with coding agents
items.summary: A founder who built a whole app around planning explains why planning as a separate step stopped working.

items.title: Swarm Traces — 80,000 payloads show how OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face
items.summary: An independent team rebuilt the actual code OpenAI's agents ran against Hugging Face, from a public trail the agents left behind.

items.title: Ollaya — an Ollama-style runtime for local decision models
items.summary: Ollaya does for typed decision models what Ollama does for LLMs: one binary to pull, run and serve them locally.

items.title: Fireship — 'Meta is pivoting again... everything you missed from Connect 2026'
items.summary: Fireship's quick recap of everything Meta announced at Connect 2026.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'THE END IS NEAR... and more AI doom'
items.summary: Wes Roth's roundup of an OpenAI agent breach in Australia, Jev, and the political fight over AI risk.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar — Google's voice agents get a talking face
items.summary: Gemini 3.8 Live can now appear on screen as a lip-synced video avatar that talks, listens and uses tools in real time.

items.title: Whiteboard — an open-source app for reviewing what coding agents built
items.summary: A shared canvas where a coding agent draws diagrams of its changes, so you review the design before the line-by-line diff.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS with Voice Cloning'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen looks at the voice-cloning side of Google's new Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS model.
